As have been witnessing the delaying tactics, the manicures and the utilization of the veto by the representative of the USSR to further the chauvinistic designs of his country and in support of the aggressor with little regard for the killings and brutalities infected upon the population was taken by the representative of the imperialist United States of American 1967 with regard to the Israeli aggression in the Middle East. The roles are identical, but the actors are different.
This deplorable behavior could not be conducive to the creation and maintenance of an atmosphere of just peace and security which man is striving to achieve.
